thread:
neha: FYI seeing spike in validation rejects and downstream billing alerts for fncall route 'summarize-docs' in us-central at 14:03 UTC. Console looks noisy.

ops-bot: validator.alert: route=summarize-docs region=us-central reject_rate=0.27 -> 14:04:05 UTC

tomas: Any recent schema tightening? We turned on stricter enum checks for doc_type last deploy. Could be that.

neha: metrics snippet:
```
validator.rejects{route=\"summarize-docs\",region=\"us-central\"} = 1345 (10m)
fallback.degen{route=\"summarize-docs\"} = 1200 (10m)
customer.quota_burn{acct=acct-21} = +15% (tokens)
```

design-lee: UX: customers are seeing "tool failed" and support tickets are pinging us. We should add a clearer error tag in the API response for customers so they can retry appropriately. Maybe `x-redwood-validation: soft|hard|permissive` header.

billing: If quota spikes keep happening we need to correlate rejects -> extra token usage because of fallbacks. Propose a derived metric `tokens_wasted_by_fallback`.

neha: For now I'm toggling the validator to soft-flag for summarize-docs and attaching a 1k sample to the triage bucket.

ops-bot: validators.set: route=summarize-docs region=us-central policy=soft-flag requested_by=neha 14:10:12 UTC

tomas: We'll also add a short-circuit: if (reject_rate > 0.2) and (fallback_rate > 0.5) then auto-downgrade to permissive for 5 minutes. Adds safety for noisy rollouts.

neha: Agree but need an escape hatch so we don't flip permissive during an attacker flood. Add a limit: only auto-downgrade if origin != external-untrusted and account != flagged-by-abuse.

billing: I'm adding `tokens_wasted_by_fallback` to billing dashboards; will add a weekly alert that surfaces accounts with >10% waste.

design-lee: Console update: show validator policy and last_changed_by on route details page, and offer a "preview validator" modal that lets you paste an example response and see pass/fail with annotated reasons. That would cut down ticket volume.

neha: Filed INF-10010 (auto-downgrade safety), INF-10011 (API header for validation status), INF-10012 (console: preview validator modal). Assigning INF-10011 -> tomas, INF-10012 -> design-lee, INF-10010 -> ops.

ops-bot: ticket.created INF-10010 INF-10011 INF-10012

neha: Thanks team. We'll follow up with a short incident timeline once we confirm customer impact.
